# Pharmacy Solutions as Unique as You

## Our products

### [Talking
### Labels][43]

[[Photo of the RFID label on the bottom of a ScripTalk medication bottle]][44]

### [Extended Content
### Labels][45]

[[Photo of a ScriptView medication bottle with a large print label]][46]
[[Photo of the BrailleRx medication bottle]][47]

### [Braille
### Labels][48]

[[Photo of the En-Vision America monument]][49]

En-Vision America is a company that provides high-tech products for pharmacies. The company has
spearheaded many label-related innovations, including ScriptAbility Dual Language/Translation,
Braille, Large Print, Talking and Controlled Substance Safety Labels (CSSLs).

## About Us

[ScripTalkPharmacistWithPatient.png]

We help pharmacies provide accessible prescription labeling solutions that make medication
information clear and easy to read for every patient.

# Patient Safety
# Starts With You

## Our products

### [Talking
### Labels][50]

[[Photo of the RFID label on the bottom of a ScripTalk medication bottle]][51]

### [Extended Content
### Labels][52]

[[Photo of a ScriptView medication bottle with a large print label]][53]
[[Photo of the BrailleRx medication bottle]][54]

### [Braille
### Labels][55]

By providing accessible prescription labels, your patients can independently and safely manage their
prescriptions, reduce medication errors and increase adherence. 


Our equipment is plug and play, easy to use and small enough to not disturb your pharmacy’s current
workflow. The suite encompasses [Audible,][56] [Dual Language/Translation,][57] [Large
Print,][58] [Controlled Substance Safety (CSSL)][59] and [Braille][60] labels. It’s an all-in-one
interface that requires minimal setup on Windows 10 v1903 (19H1) and higher.


Join the ever-growing list of national chain and private pharmacies ensuring their patients' safety
and medication adherence with accessible labels. We can answer any questions you may have and help
you determine what best suits your patient's needs.


## WHAT OUR PHARMACIES SAY

"We continue to look for new ways to advance the entire landscape of pharmacy technology, which
includes fostering a healthcare environment that prioritizes inclusivity and patient safety."

—  Maureen Meyer, Vice President of Product Management at McKesson

looking for a screen reader, like our world renowned JAWS software or a magnification software such

With a wide range of refreshable braille displays, we offer many options to fit your needs.
Engineered for portability ruggedness and ease of use, our line of Focus braille displays are
lightweight, full-featured and designed to fit the needs of your busy lifestyle.

[View Blindness Products][37]

## Software Solutions

Freedom Scientific provides software solutions for blind and low vision needs. Whether you are
looking for a screen reader, like our world renowned JAWS software or a magnification software such
as ZoomText, we have a variety of solutions to meet your specific needs. We are dedicated to
providing the best software to provide accessibility tools for work and home.

HumanWare specializes in the design and manufacture of highly intuitive and intelligent solutions
for people living with vision loss or visual impairment. From electronic magnifiers to talking GPS
to braille devices, HumanWare solutions help all users live independently and participate
successfully in today’s world. Available in more than 25 languages, our full range of products make
us the global leader in our industry.

[Click to play video in a popup then press escape to close the popup.]
►
CLOSEFERMER

## Living independently with vision loss

Whether you are a student or worker living with a visual impairment or experience an age-related eye
condition such as macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, cataracts, or glaucoma, our solutions
allow for more active participation in the world around you.

[ Our low vision solutions ][217]
[ Learn more about vision loss ][218]
[ Learn more about vision loss ][219]
[Image of a smiling adult woman with long white hair using headphones with her audio assistant.]
[A smiling young woman touching the shoulder of her visually impaired friend wearing sunglasses.]

## Audio assistants and braille devices, redefining the path to success

The move toward greater integration of people living with visual impairment into schools,
workplaces, and inclusive urban mobility plans, makes assistive technologies that address their
specific needs a gateway to higher education, financial independence, and environmental literacy.

[ Browse our blindness solutions ][220]

HumanWare specializes in the design and manufacture of highly intuitive and intelligent solutions
for people living with vision loss or visual impairment. From electronic magnifiers to talking GPS
to braille devices, HumanWare solutions help all users live independently and participate
successfully in today’s world. Available in more than 25 languages, our full range of products make
us the global leader in our industry.

[Click to play video in a popup then press escape to close the popup.]
►
CLOSEFERMER

## Living independently with vision loss

Whether you are a student or worker living with a visual impairment or experience an age-related eye
condition such as macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, cataracts, or glaucoma, our solutions
allow for more active participation in the world around you.

[ Our low vision solutions ][217]

[A smiling young woman touching the shoulder of her visually impaired friend wearing sunglasses.]

## Audio assistants and braille devices, redefining the path to success

The move toward greater integration of people living with visual impairment into schools,
workplaces, and inclusive urban mobility plans, makes assistive technologies that address their
specific needs a gateway to higher education, financial independence, and environmental literacy.

[ Browse our blindness solutions ][220]

OrCam Update: Commitment to Our Low Vision Community

OrCam remains committed to providing our Low Vision users with the highest quality, most advanced,
and robust products. We remain focused on our Low Vision users by providing advancements and support
to our users. We are working closely with our US-based distributors to best address your needs
seamlessly. Customer Support, Research & Development, Manufacturing, and Operations continue to
function and respond to our users' needs. Our devices are warehoused in the United States to ship
out directly and we look to further minimize delay in getting our products out to our users. We are
excited to announce that with the use of our OrCam App, available on both Android and iOS, users
will experience software updates regularly and seamlessly without additional steps for the
appropriate devices. We appreciate your support and commitment to our Read and MyEye products to
support greater independence for our low-vision and blind users. For further information or support
please reach out to our US distributors or on the website for your direct contact.

# Empowering

# Accessibility

# with AI

OrCam leverages AI for handheld and wearable assistive solutions, catering to the visually impaired
and those with reading challenges.

[
Contact Us
][19] [
Find Us Near You
][20]

OrCam Update: Commitment to Our Low Vision Community

OrCam remains committed to providing our Low Vision users with the highest quality, most advanced,
and robust products. We remain focused on our Low Vision users by providing advancements and support
to our users. We are working closely with our US-based distributors to best address your needs
seamlessly. Customer Support, Research & Development, Manufacturing, and Operations continue to
function and respond to our users' needs. Our devices are warehoused in the United States to ship
out directly and we look to further minimize delay in getting our products out to our users. We are
excited to announce that with the use of our OrCam App, available on both Android and iOS, users
will experience software updates regularly and seamlessly without additional steps for the
appropriate devices. We appreciate your support and commitment to our Read and MyEye products to
support greater independence for our low-vision and blind users. For further information or support
please reach out to our US distributors or on the website for your direct contact.

# VisionAware

[VisionAware logo]

Are you or a family member having difficulty seeing? Or perhaps been diagnosed with an eye condition
such as [macular degeneration,][35] [cataracts][36], [glaucoma][37], or [diabetic retinopathy][38]?
If the answer is yes, you’re not alone: vision problems affect 25 million Americans, and they are on
the rise.

VisionAware is a free, easy-to-use informational service for adults who are blind or have low
vision, their families, caregivers, healthcare providers, and social service professionals. Visitors
will find tips and resources on living with blindness or low vision and information on eye diseases
and disorders.

[Connect with VisionAware on Facebook][39]
Share This:
[Photo of two Getting Started Guides. The left cover shows an older photo of three older adults
gathered around a large-print or tactile reading page, titled "Getting Started: Top Five Tips for
Navigating Life with Vision Loss." The right cover shows a newer photo of three people of different
generations smiling while looking at a tablet, titled "Getting Started Guide: Navigating Life with
Vision Loss."]

## Getting Started Guides

APH ConnectCenter’s Getting Started Guides provide information and resources for individuals who are
blind or have low vision, as well as their families and professionals who support them. Topics
include vision development, navigating IFSPs and IEPs, braille literacy, technology, transition to
college and careers, and practical strategies for building independence at every stage of life. […]

[Read more][40]
[Older person and young teen put their arms around each other]

## New to Vision Loss?

Starting a journey with vision loss can feel overwhelming, but you don’t have to navigate blindness
or low vision alone. Welcome to “New to Vision Loss?,” your essential starting point for this new
chapter. This section offers clear, supportive, and practical information on emotional adjustment
and support groups, vision rehabilitation, medication management, and more designed […]

[Read more][41]
[Woman sitting in kitchen reading braille.]

## Living with Blindness or Low Vision

If you are new to blindness or low vision, take the journey one day and one step at a time. Utilize
our tips for adjusting to vision changes, living independently, caring for yourself, navigating
relationships, getting around your environment, redesigning your home and fall prevention, making
home and vehicle repairs, maintaining employment, and choosing where […]

# Every Digital Experience. Accessible to Every Person. Everywhere.

Vispero’s assistive technology and digital accessibility expertise open doors to independence and
inclusion for all.

[ For organizations ][48]
[ For individuals ][49]

## Digital accessibility is essential for everyone

### Vispero combines assistive technology and digital accessibility expertise to make inclusion
### achievable.

More than one billion people worldwide experience some form of disability, yet too many digital
experiences still leave them behind. Inaccessible design limits independence, participation, and
inclusion, and increases risk for organizations that fail to meet global accessibility standards.

Vispero helps close this gap by ensuring every user and every business can participate fully in the
digital world.

Accessibility requires ownership, not isolated projects. Vispero’s Digital Accessibility Services

## Assistive Technology, evolving through experience and innovation

Built and tested by people who are blind or have low vision, Vispero’s assistive technology
solutions bring clarity, confidence, and connection to every digital environment. Artificial
intelligence removes barriers that once slowed navigation, while cloud-ready design keeps settings,
licenses, and productivity moving seamlessly across devices. Reliable performance and inclusive
experiences ensure accessibility works everywhere, from secure enterprise systems to classrooms and
personal workspaces.

## Accessibility built into self-service

Across retail, financial services, healthcare, and travel, self-service technology is becoming core
infrastructure. JAWS for Kiosk embeds trusted assistive technology directly into these environments,
enabling independent, secure transactions for people who are blind or low vision. By designing
accessibility into physical-digital touchpoints from the start, organizations strengthen compliance,
customer trust, and long-term operational resilience.
[ Explore JAWS for Kiosk ][65]

From individuals gaining independence to enterprises embedding accessibility at scale, Vispero
connects progress to people.

We’re driven by lived experience and deep expertise, always focused on the people behind the
technology. Our impact is measured in lives empowered, organizations transformed, and a future made
more inclusive every day. Together, we’re shaping a future where accessibility is the standard, not
the exception.

AAC Funding

# Your PRC-Saltillo
# Funding Guide

Speech-generating devices (SGD) can be funded by Medicaid, Medicare, commercial insurance, and
military insurance. From start to finish, we're here to help you through this process.

**Ready to get started?

[Log in][23] or [create an account][24]
We’ll walk you through the rest!**

Tell me about the
Funding Process

Learn about the basics of speech-generating device funding through your health insurance.

[Read More][25]

Help!
I don't know where to start

Connect with your local consultant to learn about our devices, services, and support.

Go
^{}

It's go time!
Let's get started

To apply for a trial or purchase of one of our devices, you'll need an account. Log in with your
existing PRC-Saltillo account or create one.

[Log in][26] [New Account][27]

# Get Funded.

Don't fret about funding. We’re here to help.

[How To Obtain Funding Icon]

How To Obtain Funding

Learn about the funding process, from trial device to getting your very own, and everything in
between.

[Read More][28]
[Frequently Asked Questions Icon]

Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to common questions regarding the funding process such as: I know what device I want,
what next? Does my insurance cover speech generating devices? What forms do I need to complete?

[Read More][29]
[Insurance Tips Icon]

Insurance Tips

As you begin the process of working with your insurance company to obtain a device, they'll have
questions for you. We’ve compiled a list of codes, documents, and other items you’ll need before you
make that first call – and after.

[Read More][30]
[Funding Glossary Icon]

Funding Glossary

What’s an AOB? What does CMN stand for? Our list of commonly-used funding and insurance terms will
help you “learn the jargon” as you work on funding your device.

[Read More][31]
[Deferrals and Denials Icon]

Deferrals & Denials

A deferral or a denial from your insurance company is not the end of the road. Learn the difference
between the two decisions and how PRC-Saltillo will continue to work on your behalf to try and get a
favorable outcome.

[Read More][32]

Blog

Read about hot topics in Funding for AAC.

[Read More][33]

Templates & Samples

View or download sample AAC Evaluations for clients with a variety of diagnoses. In addition,
examples of Addendums and Appeals are provided.

[Read More][34]

Alternate Funding Sources

Learn about Alternate Funding sources for AAC such as Easter Seals and CareCredit.

[Read More][35]
View More

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

Need assistance exploring accommodation solutions?

[Ask JAN!  We can help.][30]

(800) 526-7234

## Follow JAN on Social Media

[

#### Job Accommodation Network

][32]
[ 2026-07-24T18:00:01+0000 ][33] [ [Facebook post] ][34]

Become a participating school in the Workforce Recruitment Program. College and university staff can
visit [https://www.WRP.gov/][35] and sign up to help support their students and recent graduates
with disabilities seeking federal job opportunities this fall.

[

#### Job Accommodation Network

][36]
[ 2026-07-24T14:00:16+0000 ][37] [ [Facebook post] ][38]

As we recognize the anniversary of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), it's an opportunity to
reflect on the progress that has been made in expanding access and opportunity in the workplace. For
more than 40 years, JAN has provided free, expert guidance on workplace accommodations and
ADA-related topics, helping employers and workers with disabilities navigate the accommodation
process with practical, individualized solutions. Explore JAN's resources:
[https://AskJAN.org/index.cfm][39]

[

#### Job Accommodation Network

][40]
[ 2026-07-23T14:00:06+0000 ][41] [ [Facebook post] ][42]

Workplace accommodations can play an important role in helping employees perform their jobs
effectively. The Job Accommodation Network's new Mental Health Hub is a centralized resource
featuring practical accommodation solutions, ADA information, employer guidance, accommodation
scenarios, and tools designed to strengthen productivity, retention, and workplace success. Explore
the Mental Health Hub: [https://AskJAN.org/mental_health_hub/][43]

[

#### Job Accommodation Network

][44]
[ 2026-07-22T18:00:10+0000 ][45] [ [Facebook post] ][46]

Did You Know? Requesting a workplace accommodation doesn't require special legal language or a
complicated form. A simple written request can describe your work-related limitations, suggest
accommodation ideas, and help start the interactive process. If you're unsure where to begin, the
Job Accommodation Network offers sample language to help you draft an accommodation request letter.
Explore the resource: [https://AskJAN.org/media/accommrequestltr.cfm][47]

[

#### Job Accommodation Network

][48]
[ 2026-07-21T14:00:07+0000 ][49] [ [Facebook post] ][50]

October is National Disability Employment Awareness Month, a great time to help your team strengthen
its knowledge of workplace accommodations. The Job Accommodation Network offers free virtual
training on topics such as using JAN services, the accommodation process, and workplace
accommodation solutions. If you're planning an October event, contact JAN now to learn about
available topics and reserve a training date! Learn more about JAN training:
[https://AskJAN.org/events/Training.cfm][51]

[

#### Job Accommodation Network

][52]
[ 2026-07-20T14:00:04+0000 ][53] [ [Facebook post] ][54]

National Disability Employment Awareness Month (NDEAM) takes place annually in October, but planning
for it gets started well before. The U.S. Department of Labor just released the official 2026 poster
to help. Download or order yours today to join in "Celebrating Value and Talent" and honoring
America’s 250th birthday! [https://www.dol.gov/ndeam][55]

[

#### Job Accommodation Network

][56]

demanding tasks such as climbing in and out of large trucks, loading and unloading cargo, and

complicated form. A simple written request can describe your work-related limitations, suggest
accommodation ideas, and help start the interactive process. If you're unsure where to begin, the
Job Accommodation Network offers sample language to help you draft an accommodation request letter.
Explore the resource: [https://AskJAN.org/media/accommrequestltr.cfm][47]

#### Job Accommodation Network

][48]
[ 2026-07-21T14:00:07+0000 ][49] [ [Facebook post] ][50]

its knowledge of workplace accommodations. The Job Accommodation Network offers free virtual
training on topics such as using JAN services, the accommodation process, and workplace
accommodation solutions. If you're planning an October event, contact JAN now to learn about
available topics and reserve a training date! Learn more about JAN training:
[https://AskJAN.org/events/Training.cfm][51]

[

#### Job Accommodation Network

][52]

for it gets started well before. The U.S. Department of Labor just released the official 2026 poster
to help. Download or order yours today to join in "Celebrating Value and Talent" and honoring
America’s 250th birthday! [https://www.dol.gov/ndeam][55]

[

#### Job Accommodation Network

][56]
[ 2026-07-17T18:09:39+0000 ][57] [ [Facebook post] ][58]

Truck drivers keep goods and supplies moving nationwide, but the job can involve physically
demanding tasks such as climbing in and out of large trucks, loading and unloading cargo, and
performing maintenance and repairs. Motor-related impairments such as back pain, lifting
restrictions, or difficulty reaching and bending can make these tasks more challenging. A NEW Job
Accommodation Network resource shares practical accommodation ideas to help truck drivers with motor
impairments perform essential job tasks safely and effectively. While every situation is unique, the
resource offers a helpful starting point for identifying solutions that support productivity and job
performance. Learn more:
[https://AskJAN.org/articles/Accommodating-Truck-Drivers-with-Motor-Impairments.cfm][59]

[

#### Job Accommodation Network

][60]
[ 2026-07-16T14:00:08+0000 ][61] [ [Facebook post] ][62]

p.m. ET for a free webinar exploring today's manufacturing workforce landscape. Part of EARN's
Industry Spotlight Webinar Series, this session will feature an expert discussion with a
representative from the Manufacturing Institute, followed by a live Q&A. Tune in to explore: -
Manufacturing recruitment and retention trends - Upskilling and reskilling strategies that support
employee retention and advancement - Workplace supports for workers with disabilities - Practical
ways to strengthen talent pipelines and retain workers Register now for the "Strengthening the
Manufacturing Industry: Recruit, Re-Train, and Retain Valuable Workforce Talent" webinar:
[https://askearn.org/event/strengthening-the-manufacturing-industry][63]

#### Job Accommodation Network

][64]

and Essential Occupations," a free webcast focused on workplace accommodation strategies for workers
with disabilities in skilled trades and essential occupations. Attendees will learn about: -
Practical accommodation solutions for workers with disabilities in skilled trades and essential
occupations - The accommodation process - JAN resources to support workplace decision-making This

    solution facilitates the global synchronization of healthcare product data. ][14]

## FANUC and Google: Advancing Manufacturing Intelligence

FANUC is collaborating with Google to bring cloud-native artificial intelligence capabilities to
manufacturing plants, enabling smarter automation and predictive analytics across all production
environments.

## CRX-10*i*A/L Paint

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.
This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for
uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass
industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in
accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing
applications.

[ CRX-10iA/L Paint ][134]

## FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Industrial Robotics, Leveraging NVIDIA Technologies

FANUC is combining its global leadership in robotics with NVIDIA’s AI computing and simulation
platforms to deliver intelligent and adaptable automation. This collaboration integrates ROBOGUIDE
with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to create photorealistic digital twins, and enables robots to
interpret voice commands and automatically generate code.

### Frequently asked questions

### What is GeoGuessr?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is a geography game, in which you are dropped somewhere in the world in a street view
panorama and your mission is to find clues and guess your location on the world map.

### I have trouble accessing my account.

[Show]
If you've forgot your password, click on "Already have an account?" in the upper right corner, and
then on "Forgot your password?". Enter the email address which is connected to your account, and
we'll send you an email with a link to reset your password! Don't forget to check you spam email if
it may have gotten caught there.
If you are not receiving an email you might have enabled Google/Facebook login. If so, send an email
to [our support team][15] and we will help you further. If you've forgotten which email you signed
up with, no worries! Contact us at [our support team][16] and we'll help you out!

### Is GeoGuessr available on App Store and Google Play?

[Show]
Yes, GeoGuessr is available on iOS and Android, and your account lets you play on the app as well.

### What languages is GeoGuessr available in?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is available in 11 different languages. You can select language in the website footer
under "Change language".

### What is Seterra?

[Show]
Become a geography expert and have fun at the same time! Seterra is an entertaining and educational
geography game that gives you access to over 400 customizable quizzes. Seterra will challenge you
with quizzes about countries, capitals, flags, oceans, lakes and more!
[
Play Seterra now!
][17]

### Business enquiries

[Show]
We'd love to come in contact. To make sure your email gets to the right person, please contact us
at:
Collaborations
If you're an agency, brand, game or content creator who wants to collaborate with us, share your
ideas with [[email protected]][18].
Press/company
For press and other company related enquiries contact our CEO directly at [[email protected]][19].
Press material can be found at [https://design.geoguessr.com][20].
Customer support
If you need help regarding your GeoGuessr account, our support team is ready to help you at
[https://www.geoguessr.support][21].

# Advancing Immunization Information Systems
# to Strengthen Public Health

###### [ LEARN MORE ][93]

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Connect. Collaborate. Innovate.                                                                   
                                                                                                    
### Promoting the use of immunization information to ensure healthy communities.                    
                                                                                                    
AIRA is a leading membership organization dedicated to advancing immunization information systems   
(IIS) and supporting the immunization community. Through collaboration, education, and trusted      
[resources][94], we empower our [members and partners][95] to improve public health and protect     
communities from vaccine-preventable diseases. [Join AIRA][96] in making an impact!                 
                                                                                                    
### **New CDS Resources**                                                                           
                                                                                                    
AIRA's Clinical Decision Support (CDS) resources include a [microlearning][97] course,              
[one-sheet][98], and a new [web page][99] to help you stay informed.                                
                                                                                                    
### AIRA 2027 National Meeting                                                                      
                                                                                                    
Mark your calendars! The AIRA 2027 National Meeting will take place **May 25–27** in Louisville,    
Kentucky. We hope you'll join us!**                                                                 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

AIRA is a leading membership organization dedicated to advancing immunization information systems   
(IIS) and supporting the immunization community. Through collaboration, education, and trusted      
[resources][94], we empower our [members and partners][95] to improve public health and protect     
communities from vaccine-preventable diseases. [Join AIRA][96] in making an impact!                 
                                                                                                    
### **New CDS Resources**                                                                           
                                                                                                    
AIRA's Clinical Decision Support (CDS) resources include a [microlearning][97] course,              
[one-sheet][98], and a new [web page][99] to help you stay informed.                                
                                                                                                    
### AIRA 2027 National Meeting                                                                      
                                                                                                    
Mark your calendars! The AIRA 2027 National Meeting will take place **May 25–27** in Louisville,    
Kentucky. We hope you'll join us!**

# **Our Mission**Our Mission

Meaningful work changes lives. LCI is in the business of providing meaningful employment for people
who are blind.

## **EMPLOY**EMPLOY

We are one of the largest employers of Americans who are blind or visually impaired. We create
meaningful work for our employees and superior solutions for our customers.

## **BUILD**BUILD

We manufacture over 2,000 products across America, and distribute and sell thousands more.

## **SERVE**SERVE

We operate 50 base supply centers serving US military servicemembers with over 2 million products.

## **SUPPORT**SUPPORT

organizations.

# **employee perspective**employee perspective

## Starlyn Lockhart

> I moved to North Carolina several years ago from Pennsylvania in search of a new job. Because I am
> visually impaired, I knew that finding a job was going to be a challenge. I was looking for a
> company that would give me the opportunity to learn a new skillset. After being with LCI for a
> little over 4 years, I can say that this company is what I was looking for.

Starlyn Lockhart

## Alyssa Cheeseman

> I like the inclusivity of LCI in that they are trying to make changes in upper management to be
> able to increase the upward mobility of people who are blind . I also Like that we as people who
> are blind are given the chance to reach our potential throughout the company.

Alyssa Cheeseman

## George Mason

> I like working at LCI for numerous reasons. Foremost, working has helped me to regain my
> self-respect and my dignity. Because of my vision loss, I was unemployed and I had lost all

# Семейный ресторан средиземноморской кухни

[Lewis Carroll Society of North America]

Welcome to the Lewis Carroll Society of North America (LCSNA) website. The LCSNA is a non-profit
organization dedicated to promoting awareness and appreciation of the life, work, times, and
influence of Lewis Carroll (Charles Lutwidge Dodgson). Through conferences, public programs,
publications, research projects, and communications, we work to create knowledge and share awareness
of Carroll’s contributions to society and culture around the world. We are collectors, scholars,
actors, and enthusiasts of all ages and walks of life who share an affinity for *Alice’s Adventures
in Wonderland* and its heroine Alice (and enjoy much of muchness).

[Lewis Carroll]

**Charles Lutwidge Dodgson, **
*better known as*
**Lewis Carroll** (1832–1898)

## [Join Us][47]

[Join Us]

If you would like to help, or if you simply enjoy Carroll’s writing, please review the benefits of
joining on our [Membership][48] page.

**[Members Only][49] content is available after you join the Society.**

## [Donate][50]

Part of the charter of the Lewis Carroll Society of North America (LCSNA) is to foster Lewis Carroll
studies and promote awareness of Carroll and his works. You can [donate][51] to any of our worthy
[LCSNA funds][52].
* [Happy Birthday, Lewis Carroll!] January 27 is Charles Lutwidge Dodgson’s birthday. He was born in
  1832 at Daresbury Parsonage, Cheshire.
  
   
  
  (Tatiana Ianovskaia, 2007)
* [The Knight Letter]
  
   
  
  All LCSNA members receive twice-yearly copies of the Society’s journal as they are published, free
  of charge.
  
   
  
  [Learn more and view a past issue.][53]
  
  (Cover Illustration, Fall 2018)

[Lewis Carroll Society of North America]

Welcome to the Lewis Carroll Society of North America (LCSNA) website. The LCSNA is a non-profit
organization dedicated to promoting awareness and appreciation of the life, work, times, and
influence of Lewis Carroll (Charles Lutwidge Dodgson). Through conferences, public programs,
publications, research projects, and communications, we work to create knowledge and share awareness
of Carroll’s contributions to society and culture around the world. We are collectors, scholars,
actors, and enthusiasts of all ages and walks of life who share an affinity for *Alice’s Adventures
in Wonderland* and its heroine Alice (and enjoy much of muchness).

[Lewis Carroll]

**Charles Lutwidge Dodgson, **
*better known as*
**Lewis Carroll** (1832–1898)

## [Join Us][47]

joining on our [Membership][48] page.

**[Members Only][49] content is available after you join the Society.**

Part of the charter of the Lewis Carroll Society of North America (LCSNA) is to foster Lewis Carroll
studies and promote awareness of Carroll and his works. You can [donate][51] to any of our worthy
[LCSNA funds][52].

The North Carolina Assistive Technology Program (NCATP) leads North Carolina's       │ │            
efforts to carry out the federal Assistive Technology Act of 2004. We promote        │ │            
independence for people with disabilities through access to technology               │ │            
****                                                                                 │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
**NCATP Regional Centers provide:**                                                  │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
#### ****                                                                            │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
**                                                                                   │ │            
** ** **Device Demonstration �  Get hands on experience with equipment.              │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
Device Loan � Borrow a device short term to try it out.                              │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
Device Reutilization � Find used equipment on the Technology Exchange Post**         │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
**Training and Technical Assistance � Receive assistive technology expertise.        │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
Public Awareness � Get a general overview of AT and NCATP services.                  │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
Coordination & Collaboration � NCATP networks with agencies and organizations        │ │            
regionally and statewide  so that AT issues are included in planning and policy      │ │            
development.                                                                         │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
The North Carolina Assistive Technology Program (NCATP) is a state and federally     │ │            
funded program that provides assistive technology services statewide to people of all│ │            
ages and abilities.                                                                  │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
#### What is Assistive Technology?                                                   │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
Assistive technology is any item, piece of equipment, or product, whether acquired   │ │            
commercially, modified, or customized, that is used to increase, maintain, or improve│ │            
functional capabilities of an individual with a disability.                          │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
                                                                                     │ │            
#### Categories of Assistive Technology                                              │ │            
                                                                                     │ │

With Progressive, you can take your boat to any lake or river, plus ocean waters within 75 miles of
the coast. And we offer a variety of coverages to protect your boat and the good times that come
with it. Quote now to get started.

**Why Progressive?:** With on-water towing, fuel spill removal, mechanical breakdown coverage, and
more, you can float on without worry.

#### Get the coverage you need to keep your business growing

From general liability to cyber insurance, you can find the coverages you need to protect your
company from severe financial loss. Start a quote today and safeguard your business from the
unexpected.

[Learn more about business][35]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][36]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][37]

#### Cover yourself for everything your condo association doesn't

Your home's structure may be protected, but what about everything inside? With condo insurance, you
can be covered for theft, damage, and more. Get a quote today for greater peace of mind.

**Why Progressive?:** We cover your belongings, temporary living expenses, home upgrades, and more
so you don’t have to worry about gaps in coverage.

[Learn more about condo][38]

#### Safeguard your most valuable asset

Protect your home, belongings, and financial security with homeowners insurance. With a variety of
coverages, and plenty of ways to save, you can create a policy that keeps your home safe and fits
your budget. Get a quote today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can instantly compare rates and coverages from multiple companies
side-by-side to find the right policy for you.

[Learn more about homeowners][39]

#### Give your family the safety net they deserve

Term life insurance can provide you and your family with long-lasting financial security. You
determine how much coverage you need, how long you need it, who you’d like covered, and when you
pay—giving you control of your policy. Quote now to get started.

[Learn more about term life][40]

#### Build a mobile home policy that works for you

With a range of coverages and deductible options to choose from, you can easily create an insurance
policy that protects your mobile home and works with your budget. Start building your policy today.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer specialized protection to cover porches, garages, gazebos, and more.

[Learn more about mobile home][41]

#### Ride with the #1 bike insurer starting at $75/year^{§}

If you enjoy the freedom of the open road, then you'll love the freedom of choice we give you with
our coverages. Start your quote now and create a custom policy that protects your ride wherever the
road takes you.

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all
repairs.

[Learn more about motorcycle][42]

Affordable coverage for your four-legged friend

With Progressive Pet Insurance by Pets Best, you can create a plan that fits your dog or cat's
needs, as well as your budget. Simply choose a plan and then customize your deductible,
reimbursement percentage, and annual limit.

[Learn more about pet insurance][43]

#### Protect yourself from damage, theft, and more

With renters insurance, your belongings are protected whether they're in your apartment, backseat,
or storage locker. Plus, if you can't stay in your residence due to a covered incident, we'll help
pay for your temporary living expenses. Get covered today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can get a renters policy for less than $1 per day.^{‡‡}

[Learn more about renters][44]

Whether you're a full-time RVer or an occasional road-tripper, you'll find all the coverages you
need at an affordable price right here. Get a quote now and enjoy the open road without worry.

**Why Progressive?:** From windshield & glass coverage to emergency expenses, we have your road trip
covered.

[Learn more about RV][45]

#### Umbrella insurance

Extra coverage for all your assets

Umbrella insurance provides an extra layer of liability coverage beyond what your home and auto
policy offer, with limits available up to $5 million.

[Learn more about umbrella insurance][46]

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all

When you combine Progressive auto and condo insurance, you could earn a multi-policy discount.^{Δ}

# Breaking Down Barriers

[close up of Monarch butterfly on Monarch device]

We know that access to the right tools and information at the right time can change lives. Our job
is to empower students, families, adults, and educators by breaking down educational barriers, and
creating a future that belongs to everyone.

We’ve been innovating products and technology to support people who are blind and low vision to
independently live and learn since 1858, and we’re not stopping any time soon. From everyday tools
to high tech solutions, we’re developing products for barrier breakers, dream believers, change
makers, and access warriors!

 

## Monarch RISE

Through Monarch RISE, 250 Monarchs will be distributed to employment and educational professionals
and individuals seeking competitive integrated employment (CIE) across the United States. Over five
years, APH will assess the impact of the Monarch in significantly enhancing access to achieving and
maintaining CIE for individuals who are blind, low vision or DeafBlind.

[Learn More About Monarch Rise][65]
[Student using a Monarch device]

## The Power of Partnerships: Developing eBraille Together

A worldwide file standard cannot be created alone. By utilizing the expertise of other organizations
and individuals in the blindness field, APH constructed eBraille for all to use.

[Learn More About eBraille Development][66]
[A speaker stands behind a podium in front of convention audience.]

## Leveling the Playing Field

Danielle Burton, APH’s Communications Accessibility Editor, has long hoped for a piece of access
technology that levels the playing field for students who are DeafBlind, like herself. The Monarch
is just what Danielle has been waiting for.

[Learn More About Danielle's Monarch Experience][67].

[Learn More About Monarch Training][68]
[A woman in a striped sweater helps a young boy use the Monarch on a table in a school library.]

## Connect the Dots 2025

Embark on an adventure of discovery into the playful world of Connect the Dots—an educational series
that turns the history and innovation of blindness and low vision into an exciting adventure for
kids! We’re on a mission to make learning fun and inspire a world where everyone is welcome. While
our building is under renovation, the PNC Foundation is helping us bring our knowledge into the
community.

[Learn More about Connect the Dots][69].

[Connect the Dots Graphic - Join us monthly to discover the magic of Inclusivity through the power
of play. Sponsored by PNC Foundation]

## APH Hive: Professional Communities

[Professional Communities][70] was created to provide creditable and effective resources to people
who assist individuals who are blind or have low vision. This user-friendly portal houses curated
webinars, external courses, blogs, and much more. Looking for a place to connect? Join us at the
[APH Hive Discussion Boards][71] to communicate with other parents and educators in the blindness
and low vision field.

[View from over the shoulder of someone visiting the professional communities main page on their
laptop.]

[View from over the shoulder of someone visiting the professional communities main page on their

## APH ConnectCenter

The APH ConnectCenter offers FREE curated advice and resources to assist children, parents, adults,
and job seekers who are blind and low vision, and their associated professionals. Visit the [APH
ConnectCenter][72], or call our information & resource helpline at 800-232-5463.

[APH ConnectCenter wordmark.]

## Find us on the road.

APH is on the go! Check out the conferences, conventions, and other events we're attending this year
on our [conference hub][73]!

[APH Conference team at CSUN 2024 conference]

## APH celebrates change makers!

Listen along to our [Change Makers podcast][74] as we highlight the people, products, and resources
making the biggest difference in our field.

[Change maker banner silhouette of people in colored square backgrounds.]

## What’s the best way to learn? Your way!

From free webinars and trainings, to professional development, virtual student instruction, and
summer camp—our [Educational Resources][75] are designed for vision professionals, educators,
parents, consumers, and students. There’s something for everyone!

[A young girl at a computer station in a classroom.]

## National Prison Braille Network

Since 2001, APH has taken a lead role in developing this network to get much-needed quality braille
textbooks to students who are blind in grades K–12. Learn more about how the [NPBN is changing lives
for the better][76].

[A child sitting in a blue armchair and reading a braille storybook.]

## APH Press

[APH Press][77] is the leading publisher in the field of blindness and visual impairment, supporting
teachers, families, and other professionals by publishing informative, well-researched, and
innovative texts which enable people of all abilities to maximize their potential and independence.

[Babies with CVI book sits atop a desk, next to a laptop, APH mug, and pad of paper and pen.]

## Resources for Life

### APH Hive

Buzz over to our free eLearning platform for educators and families.

[APH Hive][78]

### APH Connect Center

Reliable, free information for all ages on multiple aspects of vision loss.

[APH ConnectCenter][79]

### Accessible Textbooks

Unlock students’ educational potential with access to accessible textbooks.

[Accessible Textbooks][80]

### APH Press

Titles for professionals on a wide range of topics including education, O&M, aging, and more.

[APH Press][81]

### Louis

Explore the Louis Database of Accessible Materials to find materials from 75+ organizations across
U.S. and Canada.

[Louis][82]

### Outreach Services

Learn about our consultation and educational support for students, educators, and families.

[Outreach Services][83]

## 10-Line Braille Display

With 3840 pins, Monarch has one of the highest definition displays in braille history! Read up to
ten lines of braille at one time.

[Learn More About Monarch][84]
[A top-down view of the Monarch device. In the center is a 10-line 40-cell braille display
underneath a Monarch logo at the top of the device.]

## Android Navigation Keys

Android users may recognize the three keys on the front edge of the Monarch. They serve as shortcuts
for moving back one screen, the home screen, and recent apps.

[Learn More About Monarch][85]
[Close up of the front edge of the Monarch device. There are three yellow navigation keys (a
triangle on the far left, a circle in the center, and a square button on the right).]

## Perkins-Style Keyboard

Braille directly on your Monarch with the eight-key Perkins-Style keyboard.

[Learn More About Monarch][86]
[Close up of the Monarch eight-key braille keyboard. There are four keys on each side with a space
bar underneath. In the center is an orange circular button called the “action key.” Visible on the
edges of the photo are portions of the Monarch, APH, and HumanWare logos.]

## Infrared Sensor

The motion sensor at the top of your Monarch’s display screen enables point-and-click gestures as
well as finger tracking on the visual braille output.

[Learn More About Monarch][87]
[Close up of Monarch logo on the device just above the tactile display. There is a small indentation
in the plastic that aligns with the motion sensor.]

## Battery Life

Monarch boasts a battery life of 24 hours from just 3 or 4 hours of charging time.

[Learn More About Monarch][88]
[Close up of Monarch logo on the device just above the tactile display. There is a small indentation
in the plastic that aligns with the motion sensor.]

## Visual Display

Monarch can connect to an external monitor via HDMI so teachers and peers of all abilities can join
along.

[Learn More About Monarch][89]
[Over-the-shoulder image of a young student in a blue shirt using the Monarch connected to a visual
display in a library. The monitor mirrors a mathematical graph created in Monarch’s KeyMath app that
is also shown on the Monarch’s tactile display.]

## Donate Today.

People of all ages who are blind or low vision benefit from APH’s extraordinary programs and
innovative products. Be a part of our mission and partner with us.

[Donate Today][90]
[A proud dad holding his smiling son]

## Stay in the know.

Be the first to get updates on our latest products, resources, conferences and more by signing up
for our monthly newsletter.

[Subscribe Now][91]

and low vision field.

[View from over the shoulder of someone visiting the professional communities main page on their
laptop.]

## APH ConnectCenter

The APH ConnectCenter offers FREE curated advice and resources to assist children, parents, adults,
and job seekers who are blind and low vision, and their associated professionals. Visit the [APH
ConnectCenter][72], or call our information & resource helpline at 800-232-5463.

[APH ConnectCenter wordmark.]

## Find us on the road.

APH is on the go! Check out the conferences, conventions, and other events we're attending this year
on our [conference hub][73]!

[APH Conference team at CSUN 2024 conference]

## APH celebrates change makers!

Listen along to our [Change Makers podcast][74] as we highlight the people, products, and resources
making the biggest difference in our field.

[Change maker banner silhouette of people in colored square backgrounds.]

## What’s the best way to learn? Your way!

From free webinars and trainings, to professional development, virtual student instruction, and
summer camp—our [Educational Resources][75] are designed for vision professionals, educators,
parents, consumers, and students. There’s something for everyone!

[A young girl at a computer station in a classroom.]

## National Prison Braille Network

Since 2001, APH has taken a lead role in developing this network to get much-needed quality braille
textbooks to students who are blind in grades K–12. Learn more about how the [NPBN is changing lives
for the better][76].

[A child sitting in a blue armchair and reading a braille storybook.]

## APH Press

[APH Press][77] is the leading publisher in the field of blindness and visual impairment, supporting
teachers, families, and other professionals by publishing informative, well-researched, and
innovative texts which enable people of all abilities to maximize their potential and independence.

[Babies with CVI book sits atop a desk, next to a laptop, APH mug, and pad of paper and pen.]

## Resources for Life

### APH Hive

Buzz over to our free eLearning platform for educators and families.

[APH Hive][78]

### APH Connect Center

Reliable, free information for all ages on multiple aspects of vision loss.

[APH ConnectCenter][79]

### Accessible Textbooks

Unlock students’ educational potential with access to accessible textbooks.

[Accessible Textbooks][80]

### APH Press

Titles for professionals on a wide range of topics including education, O&M, aging, and more.

[APH Press][81]

### Louis

Explore the Louis Database of Accessible Materials to find materials from 75+ organizations across
U.S. and Canada.

[Louis][82]

### Outreach Services

Learn about our consultation and educational support for students, educators, and families.

[Outreach Services][83]

## 10-Line Braille Display

With 3840 pins, Monarch has one of the highest definition displays in braille history! Read up to
ten lines of braille at one time.

[Learn More About Monarch][84]
[A top-down view of the Monarch device. In the center is a 10-line 40-cell braille display
underneath a Monarch logo at the top of the device.]

## Android Navigation Keys

Android users may recognize the three keys on the front edge of the Monarch. They serve as shortcuts
for moving back one screen, the home screen, and recent apps.

[Learn More About Monarch][85]
[Close up of the front edge of the Monarch device. There are three yellow navigation keys (a
triangle on the far left, a circle in the center, and a square button on the right).]

## Perkins-Style Keyboard

Braille directly on your Monarch with the eight-key Perkins-Style keyboard.

[Learn More About Monarch][86]
[Close up of the Monarch eight-key braille keyboard. There are four keys on each side with a space
bar underneath. In the center is an orange circular button called the “action key.” Visible on the
edges of the photo are portions of the Monarch, APH, and HumanWare logos.]

## Infrared Sensor

The motion sensor at the top of your Monarch’s display screen enables point-and-click gestures as
well as finger tracking on the visual braille output.

[Learn More About Monarch][87]
[Close up of Monarch logo on the device just above the tactile display. There is a small indentation
in the plastic that aligns with the motion sensor.]

## Battery Life

Monarch boasts a battery life of 24 hours from just 3 or 4 hours of charging time.

[Learn More About Monarch][88]
[Close up of Monarch logo on the device just above the tactile display. There is a small indentation
in the plastic that aligns with the motion sensor.]

## Visual Display

Monarch can connect to an external monitor via HDMI so teachers and peers of all abilities can join
along.

[Learn More About Monarch][89]
[Over-the-shoulder image of a young student in a blue shirt using the Monarch connected to a visual
display in a library. The monitor mirrors a mathematical graph created in Monarch’s KeyMath app that
is also shown on the Monarch’s tactile display.]

## Donate Today.

People of all ages who are blind or low vision benefit from APH’s extraordinary programs and
innovative products. Be a part of our mission and partner with us.

[Donate Today][90]
[A proud dad holding his smiling son]

## Stay in the know.

Be the first to get updates on our latest products, resources, conferences and more by signing up
for our monthly newsletter.

[Subscribe Now][91]
[A diverse group of people looking to the front of the room and smiling]

## Privacy and peace of mind

UserWay upholds the highest standards for user privacy and security, supporting your organization’s
strict compliance with GDPR and other privacy laws. Our technology is certified by ISO 27001 and
does not collect or store your website’s user data.

## Top accessibility challenges

Learn how to navigate common digital accessibility challenges with confidence - and how UserWay can
help.

### How do I improve web accessibility fast?

Improve web accessibility instantly with the UserWay Accessibility Widget. Powered by AI, the
Widget’s automated remediation technology (ART) addresses common accessibility issues with every
page load—and it’s easy to install and activate across every website you manage.

### How do I support WCAG and ADA compliance efforts?

Strengthen accessibility governance through audits and monitoring. Work toward meeting the
requirements of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other accessibility laws with
expert-led audits that uncover violations at the source-code level, plus monitoring that provides
real-time insight on your risk.

### How do I stay accessible and compliant long-term?

Build a proactive compliance practice with integrated software and expert accessibility services
that help you move from point-in-time fixes to continuous progress. Tap into the full Level Access
solution ecosystem for the technology, support, and training you need to embed accessibility
throughout the SDLC, from design to deployment.

## Privacy and peace of mind

UserWay upholds the highest standards for user privacy and security, supporting your organization’s
strict compliance with GDPR and other privacy laws. Our technology is certified by ISO 27001 and
does not collect or store your website’s user data.

## Top accessibility challenges

Learn how to navigate common digital accessibility challenges with confidence - and how UserWay can
help.

### How do I improve web accessibility fast?

Improve web accessibility instantly with the UserWay Accessibility Widget. Powered by AI, the
Widget’s automated remediation technology (ART) addresses common accessibility issues with every
page load—and it’s easy to install and activate across every website you manage.

### How do I support WCAG and ADA compliance efforts?

Strengthen accessibility governance through audits and monitoring. Work toward meeting the
requirements of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other accessibility laws with
expert-led audits that uncover violations at the source-code level, plus monitoring that provides
real-time insight on your risk.

### How do I stay accessible and compliant long-term?

Build a proactive compliance practice with integrated software and expert accessibility services
that help you move from point-in-time fixes to continuous progress. Tap into the full Level Access
solution ecosystem for the technology, support, and training you need to embed accessibility
throughout the SDLC, from design to deployment.

## What Happens When You Can't Answer the Phone?

Your customers call someone else. Here's what changes with Zinng.

### Without Zinng

Missed calls go to voicemail. 80% of callers won't leave one.

After-hours callers hang up and call your competitor instead.

Your front desk is juggling walk-ins, paperwork, and a ringing phone.

No way for customers to text you with quick questions.

### With Zinng

Every call answered instantly, 24/7, even at 2 AM.

Callers get their questions answered and appointments booked on the spot.

Your staff focuses on the people in front of them. The AI handles the phone.

Two-way texting lets customers confirm, reschedule, or ask questions without calling.

response time increases conversion 100x

## Everything You Need

What you get with Zinng

### AI Receptionist

Trained on your business. Answers questions about your services, hours, and pricing 24/7 with a
natural American voice.

### Appointment Scheduling

Books appointments directly on the call or texts callers a scheduling link. Integrates with Cal.com,
Calendly, and more.

### Lead Capture

Collects caller name, phone, email, and reason for calling. Sends leads to your CRM through Zapier
or direct integrations.

### Two-Way SMS

Text customers directly from your Zinng inbox. Follow up on calls, send info, or answer quick
questions over text.

### Recordings & Transcripts

Every call is recorded and transcribed. Review conversations in your inbox and see exactly how each
call was handled.

### Call Transfers

When a caller needs a human, the AI transfers them directly to you or your team. Use it after hours,
all hours, or as overflow.

### Spam Filtering

Filters out robocalls and spam so you only hear from real customers.

### Outbound Web Calls

Call customers from your browser using your business number. Every call is recorded, transcribed,
and saved to your inbox.

### Flexible Phone Setup

Use your existing business number, get a new Zinng number, or forward your calls. Whatever works
best for your setup.

Now available on iOS & Android

### The Zinng app is here, on iOS and Android.

Both apps are available right now, by invite. Get notified of new calls, texts, and website chats
the moment they come in, and reply right from your phone. The same inbox you know from the web, in
your pocket. Reach out and we'll send you an invite.
